decision.actor: Social service agency in a fictional Florida dependency proceeding
decision.office: Agency responsible for specified written case-plan obligation
decision.action_or_omission: Alleged failure to deliver an expressly assigned case-plan service
decision.observed_consequence: Participant reports inability to access the assigned service; consequences require evidence

authority.jurisdiction: Florida Chapter 39 proceeding, applicability must be established

predicates.condition: Court concludes agency failed obligations specified in the written case plan

duties.required_act: Order agency to submit its plans for compliance
duties.trigger: In the opinion of the court, agency has not complied with obligations specified in the written case plan
duties.expected_output: Court direction for agency compliance plans and ensuing agency submission
exceptions: Verify complete provision and applicable procedural context

duties.required_act: Require agency to show why the child could not safely be returned home
duties.trigger: Same judicial determination of written case-plan noncompliance
duties.expected_output: Required agency showing for court evaluation; no automatic return

duties.required_act: Consider any properly presented contempt request within applicable authority
duties.trigger: Statutory predicate and all separate applicable contempt procedures
exceptions: Applicable contempt law and due process

routes.forum: Court exercising jurisdiction in existing Florida dependency case
routes.requested_relief: Judicial consideration of documented agency performance and statutory outputs if the predicate is found
prerequisites: Verify party status, operative plan, actual facts, applicable rule, notice/service and current docket
Identify exact permissible vehicle and preserve independent review clocks

document_sequence.actor: Eligible requesting party or court through scheduled review
document_sequence.document: Applicable judicial-review request, evidentiary materials and notice/service
document_sequence.receipt_or_service: Docketed filing and required service separately verified

document_sequence.document: Judicial-review order addressing statutory findings and relief
document_sequence.required_or_optional: Per applicable findings and procedural requirements

remedy.requested_result: Usable service and accurate assessment of case-plan performance, subject to applicable findings and orders
legally_required_outputs: Conditional court directives specified in 39.701(2)(d)3 when predicate is met
additional_assurance_checks: Reconcile relevant downstream records and consequences
remaining_gaps: This example supplies no real case facts, filing-ready document or calculated deadline
